scope: M03-P01-IP-004 Cloud IAM provider identity-provider runtime sync request-contract slice
implementation_summary: Added Cloud IAM provider identity-provider sync request, receipt, operation, sync-status, provider-kind, error, and port contracts in the provider-neutral domain crate.
Added OCI Identity Domain request-contract adapter crate that emits deterministic upsert/delete command shapes and receipts without OCI SDK, credentials, or network I/O.
Added self-hosted/colo IAM request-contract adapter crate that emits the same upsert/delete semantics for Oyatie-operated on-prem/colo control planes.
Registered both new adapter crates in the workspace and architecture catalog so provider-specific code stays outside Cloud IAM domain/API/app crates.
Updated M03-P01/IP-004 status to provider-runtime sync request-contract green while keeping credentialed live-provider/self-hosted smoke explicitly pending.
